facts.text: Velociraptor means 'swift thief' in Latin. The name comes from the words velox (swift) and raptor (robber).
Velociraptor was a small dinosaur that lived about 75 to 71 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous period.
Velociraptor was a type of dinosaur called a dromaeosaurid, which means 'running lizard.'
Velociraptor was about the size of a turkey, measuring 1.5 to 2 meters (5 to 7 feet) long from nose to tail.
Velociraptor stood only about 0.5 meters (1.6 feet) tall at the hip, which is about knee-height on an adult human.
Velociraptor weighed about 15 kilograms (33 pounds), roughly the weight of a medium-sized dog.
Velociraptor walked on two legs and had a long, stiff tail that helped it balance when running.
Velociraptor had a long, flat snout that made up about 60 percent of its skull length.
Scientists found bumps called quill knobs on Velociraptor arm bones, proving it had feathers.
Velociraptor had feathers but could not fly because its arms were too short and its body too heavy.
Velociraptor may have used its feathers for display, to keep warm, or to cover its eggs in the nest.
Velociraptor was warm-blooded, unlike many other reptiles.
Each foot had a large, curved claw shaped like a sickle that was over 6.5 centimeters (2.6 inches) long.
Velociraptor held its big toe claw off the ground when walking, and only used it for catching prey.
Velociraptor had about 30 sharp, serrated teeth good for tearing meat.
The hand had three long fingers, each ending in a strongly curved claw.
Velociraptor lived in what is now Mongolia and northern China, in a dry sandy environment with dunes and streams.
The climate where Velociraptor lived was hot and dry, much like a desert today.
Velociraptor shared its habitat with other dinosaurs like Protoceratops, a small plant-eating dinosaur.
Velociraptor was a carnivore, meaning it ate meat. It hunted other small animals and dinosaurs.
A famous fossil found in 1971 shows a Velociraptor locked in battle with a Protoceratops. They were buried together by a sandstorm.
Velociraptor used its big sickle claw to hold onto prey while attacking with its jaws.
Velociraptor had a large brain compared to its body size, making it one of the smarter dinosaurs.
The first Velociraptor fossil was found in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia in 1923 by explorer Peter Kaisen.
Henry Fairfield Osborn named the dinosaur Velociraptor in 1924.
Scientists have found more than a dozen Velociraptor skeletons, making it one of the best-known dinosaurs.
The famous Fighting Dinosaurs fossil was discovered in 1971 and is a national treasure of Mongolia.
In the Jurassic Park movies, Velociraptors are shown much bigger than they really were. The movie raptors are actually based on a different dinosaur called Deinonychus.
Real Velociraptors had feathers, but the movies show them with scaly skin.
The real Velociraptor was only about the size of a turkey, not as tall as a person like in the movies.
